BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing life alert services; adding a newsection to chapter 70.54 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.54 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Employees of companies providing life alert services mustprovide the location and known medical conditions of their customerswhen requested by first responders. (2) The location and known medical conditions of a customer of alife alert services company may not be shared for commercial purposeswithout the written consent of the customer. (3) For the purposes of this section For the purposes of thissection: (a) "First responder" means firefighters, law enforcement, andemergency medical personnel as recognized by this state; (b) "Life alert services" means a service provided for profit thatallows persons in need of emergency assistance to contact a call centerthrough the activation of a wearable device, such as a pendant orbracelet. p. 1 SB 6554 (4) A violation of this section is a class 1 civil infraction underRCW 7.80.120.
